name: Spacefast
summary: Publishing home for what you or your AI makes: share artifacts, host static sites, deploy web apps, manage versions and use custom domains. Made by Automattic.
description: Publishing home for what you or your AI makes: share artifacts, host static sites, deploy web apps, manage versions and use custom domains. Made by Automattic.

pricing.details: Personal 0 €, no card — 1 € of usage included every month, 20 Spaces and 20 custom domains, publish from any agent, commercial use. Go 5 €/month — everything in Personal plus 5 € usage/month, 100 Spaces and 100 custom domains, hourly database backups, choose a datacenter, email support. Pro 14 €/month — everything in Go plus 14 € usage/month, free up to 5 members then 14 €/month each, 500 Spaces and 500 custom domains, team roles and wildcard domains, priority email support. Enterprise custom (SSO, SAML, SCIM, subteams, network policies, log drains, dedicated support with SLA).
pricing.label: Freemium

features: Publish artifacts, static sites and web apps from any AI/MCP client
Private by default, with share links, passwords, custom domains and versioning
Personal plan with no card, including a small monthly usage allowance
